proposals.title: Press Enter in search box to run search / navigate to results
proposals.rationale: Home has a controlled search input (`const [query, setQuery] = useState('')`, `name="search"`, `placeholder="Search"`) with an existing `onKeyDown` handler. A search box with an Enter key handler almost always submits the query; in this app the natural target is the Products list filtered by query. The current onKeyDown only calls setQuery, so the submit/navigate behavior is not yet wired — hence speculative.

proposals.title: Search-as-you-type filters/suggests results
proposals.rationale: The input is fully controlled via `onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}` updating `query` state. A live `query` state on a labeled Search field is the canonical signal for search-as-you-type filtering or an autosuggest dropdown; the state exists but no list is rendered from it yet.

proposals.title: Autocomplete suggestions dropdown appears while typing
proposals.rationale: A controlled `query` state on a Search input typically backs a typeahead/suggestions popover that opens as the user types and lists matching products/recent searches. No dropdown is rendered in current source, so this is a plausible-but-unproven state.

proposals.title: Clear search input via clear (x) button
proposals.rationale: A controlled search field with a non-empty `query` commonly renders a clear button that resets the input to ''. setQuery('') is the obvious reset path. Not present in current markup.

proposals.title: Press Escape to clear/blur the search field
proposals.rationale: The input already has an `onKeyDown` handler, so it observes key events. Search inputs conventionally clear or dismiss suggestions on Escape. The current handler does not branch on key, so Esc handling is unproven.

proposals.title: Arrow-key navigation through search suggestions
proposals.rationale: If a typeahead suggestion list backs the `query` state, ArrowUp/ArrowDown to move the active suggestion and Enter to choose is the standard combobox keyboard pattern. The existing onKeyDown hook is where this would live. No suggestion list exists yet.

proposals.title: Debounced query handling to avoid firing on every keystroke
proposals.rationale: A search `query` updated on every onChange keystroke is the classic case for debounce/throttle before issuing a request or filtering. Current code updates state synchronously with no debounce, so this is a likely-needed-but-absent behavior.

proposals.title: Keyboard shortcut focuses the search box
proposals.rationale: Apps with a prominent Search field on the home/landing screen frequently bind a global shortcut (e.g. '/' or Cmd/Ctrl+K) to focus it. No global key listener exists in this component, so purely conventional.

proposals.title: Empty-state message when search yields no matches
proposals.rationale: Any search experience backed by `query` needs a no-results state once results are wired up. Not rendered in current minimal source.

This is inherent to react-router Link navigation already in source, though it's an implicit browser behavior rather than an explicit handler.

proposals.rationale: Home contains three focusable controls in DOM order (input, Login Link, Products Link). Tabbing moves focus through them; this is grounded in the actual rendered elements, though tab order is browser-default rather than explicitly coded.

proposals.title: Product list is a hardcoded static array of 3 ids, no fetch, sort, filter, or pagination
proposals.rationale: Products.tsx line 3 const ids = ['1','2','3'] mapped at line 9. There is no useState/useEffect/fetch, no loading/error/empty branches, no onScroll/IntersectionObserver. The many list-data proposals (search-as-you-type, sort, filter, infinite scroll, pagination, empty/skeleton/error) are all speculative for this fixture, evidenced reality is a fixed 3-item link list.

proposals.title: Browser back/forward works app-wide via BrowserRouter (SPA history)
proposals.rationale: main.tsx wraps App in <BrowserRouter>; all navigation uses Link/useNavigate, so back/forward popstate traverses the SPA history stack on every screen. A genuine app-global behavior not represented as an edge in the static graph (only forward navigations are captured).

proposals.title: Cmd/Ctrl/middle-click on any Link opens route in a new tab (react-router default)
proposals.rationale: Every screen renders react-router <Link>/<NavLink>; RR Links honor modifier and middle clicks by falling back to native anchor behavior (new tab) rather than client-side navigation. App-global, not just per-screen as currently proposed for Dashboard/Products.

proposals.title: Auth is in-memory only, page refresh logs the user out and reblocks guarded routes
proposals.rationale: auth.tsx stores isAuthenticated in useState with no localStorage/cookie/persistence. A full page reload resets it to false, so Dashboard and Checkout immediately bounce to /login. App-global session behavior (effectively instant session-expiry on refresh) absent from the graph.

proposals.title: Sign in always succeeds, no credentials, no validation, no async auth
proposals.rationale: Login.tsx onSubmit just calls login() then navigate('/dashboard'); there are no email/password inputs, no async fetch, no error/loading states in the actual component. The gathered Login proposals (type email/password, show/hide, remember me, invalid-credentials, loading, disabled-until-valid) are all speculative, evidenced login is a single unconditional button.

proposals.title:
Map is a static stub
map widget
, no pan/zoom/markers/tiles
proposals.rationale: Dashboard.tsx MapContainer (lines 4-6) returns a plain styled div with text 'map widget'. There is no map library import, no drag/scroll/marker handlers. The dashboard map proposals (pan, pinch-zoom, marker popup, tile skeleton) are all speculative against this stub.

proposals.title: Products uses NavLink (active styling) vs Settings plain Link
proposals.rationale: Dashboard.tsx line 20 uses <NavLink to="/products"> (vs plain <Link> for Settings). NavLink auto-adds aria-current/active styling when the route matches; the control-type difference between the two dashboard links is a real, code-grounded distinction worth a node.

proposals.title: Enter in notes textarea inserts a newline and does NOT submit the form
proposals.rationale: Checkout.tsx line 45 <textarea name="notes">; textareas treat Enter as newline, not submit. Only the email input and the type=submit button trigger form submit. Distinguishes the multi-line field's keyboard behavior from single-line inputs, confirms existing proposal with the code locus.

proposals.title: Any unmatched path deep-links to the 404 screen via wildcard route
proposals.rationale: App.tsx line 21 <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} /> catches all unmatched URLs; with BrowserRouter, directly entering any unknown path renders NotFound. App-global deep-link fallback behavior.

proposals.title: No submitting/disabled state, Place order can be clicked repeatedly during in-flight POST
proposals.rationale: Checkout.tsx placeOrder is async but there is no isSubmitting state and the button is never disabled, so rapid clicks can fire multiple POST /api/orders. The 'submitting/loading state' proposal is aspirational; evidenced behavior is an unguarded double-submit risk.

proposals.title: No realtime layer anywhere (no WebSocket/SSE/polling/notifications)
proposals.rationale: Searched all src: zero WebSocket, EventSource, setInterval, or polling. Any realtime proposals (live updates, presence, push notifications) are purely speculative for this app and should be flagged as not-present rather than expected.

proposals.title: No theme toggle, i18n/locale switch, or undo/redo exists in the app
proposals.rationale: No theme/dark-mode context, no i18n library, no undo/redo state in any source file. The Settings theme/language proposals and any app-global theme/i18n/undo behaviors are speculative, Settings.tsx contains only an <h1> and a Back button.

proposals.title: Settings screen has no actual settings, only a heading and Back button
proposals.rationale:
Settings.tsx is just

Settings

+ (navigate('/dashboard')). All gathered Settings proposals (toggle preference, theme, save/persist, validation, accordion, tabs, confirm-destructive, skeleton, locale) are speculative against an empty page. The one evidenced interaction is Back-to-Dashboard.

proposals.title: ConfirmDialog has no Esc handler or click-outside-to-close, only Cancel closes it
proposals.rationale: Checkout.tsx ConfirmDialog renders role="dialog" but attaches no onKeyDown/Escape listener, no backdrop/overlay, and no focus trap. The existing 'Esc closes dialog' and 'click outside dismisses' proposals are unsupported by code; only clicking Cancel (onClose) dismisses it.
